title: Fall Is in the Air, Part II
text:
Charly Triballeau / AFP / Getty

 Fall foliage is seen in Burlington, Maine, on October 13, 2026.

 Russell Cheyne / Reuters

 A statue of a deer is silhouetted against the autumnal foliage reflected on Loch Faskally in Pitlochry, Scotland, on November 2, 2026.

 Artur Widak / NurPhoto / Getty

 A red squirrel sits alert amid a carpet of autumn leaves at Rakowicki Cemetery on October 30, 2026, in Krakow, Poland.

 Ken Jack / Getty

 Barnacle geese fly above the RSPB Mersehead Reserve on the Solway Firth, after migrating from their breeding grounds in the Svalbard Archipelago, in Southerness, Scotland, on October 17, 2026.

 Lindsey Wasson / AP

 Kings Mountain is seen over the Matanuska River on October 14, 2026, near Chickaloon, Alaska.

 Hyoung Chang / The Denver Post / Getty

 Raindrops cover fall leaves in Denver on October 14, 2026.

 Samir Jordamovic / Anadolu / Getty

 Autumn foliage brings warm shades of yellow, orange, and red to the parks and promenades of Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina, on October 19, 2026.

 Creative Touch Imaging / NurPhoto / Getty

 Colorful autumn leaves in Toronto, Ontario, seen on October 25, 2026.

 Halil Sagirkaya / Anadolu / Getty

 A view of the historic Rakotzbrucke, a 19th-century bridge built with basalt stones, at Kromlau Rhododendron Park in Kromlau, Germany, on October 28, 2026. Surrounded by trees in yellow, orange, and red autumn colors, the arched bridge forms a complete circle with its reflection on the lake surface.

 Liu Yijiang / VCG / Getty

 Golden rice terraces, seen in Longji Town on October 16, 2026, in Guilin, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, China.

 Omer Urer / Anadolu / Getty

 Beech, hornbeam, oak, and maple leaves in yellow, red, brown, and green tones cover the trees around the lakes at Yedigöller National Park on October 28, 2026, with the arrival of autumn in Bolu, Turkey.

 Yasin Baturhan Ergin / Anadolu / Getty

 A stray cat walks on fallen leaves at a park in Ankara, Turkey, on October 18, 2026.

 Owen Humphreys / PA Images / Getty

 A Lakeside & Haverthwaite Railway steam train runs along the River Leven near Newby Bridge in England’s Lake District on October 29, 2026.

 Oriental Image / Reuters

 Visitors enjoy a water slide above red and yellow foliage at Hongye Shiyan Scenic Area in the district of Boshan, Zibo, in China’s Shandong province, on November 1, 2026.

 Matt Rourke / AP

 Water flows down Big Poe Creek on an autumn day in Woodward, Pennsylvania, on October 14, 2026.

 Brook Mitchell / Getty

 A red stag walks through brush at sunrise in Richmond Park on October 19, 2026, in London.

 Zhang Tao / Xinhua / Getty

 A farmer harvests corn at a farm in northeast China’s Heilongjiang Province on October 15, 2026.

 Charles Krupa / AP

 Water flows down the Contoocook River, passing the colorful foliage of trees and a covered bridge, on October 15, 2026, in Henniker, New Hampshire.

 Bao Gansheng / VCG / Getty

 A view of Mount Siguniang (Four Sisters Mountain) Scenic Area in Aba Tibetan and Qiang Autonomous Prefecture, in China’s Sichuan province, seen on October 26, 2026

 Florian Gaertner / Photothek / Getty

 Colorful leaves, seen in the Wuhlheide park in Berlin, on October 29, 2026

 Patrick Pleul / DPA / Getty

 A narrow path winds through a forest, seen on a sunny autumn day in Treplin, Germany, on November 1, 2026.
